description: Use HashiCorp Vault's secrets in workflows: read a secret or one key of it, store and update secrets, list them, see and restore their versions, encrypt and decrypt with Transit, and make strong passwords. Start a workflow when a secret is created or updated, or is due for rotation.

hashicorp_vault_secret_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a secret is created or gets a new version in a key/value engine, in the folder you choose, with its path and version (not its values). Secrets already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.age_days: Days since its current version was written
output.change: created for a new secret, updated for a new version
output.created_time: When the secret was first written
output.custom_metadata: The secret's custom metadata, such as its owner
output.folder: The folder it's in, such as apps/billing
output.link: A link to the secret in Vault
output.mount: The secrets engine, such as secret
output.name: The last part of its path, such as db
output.path: The secret's path, such as apps/billing/db
output.updated_time: When its current version was written

parameters.description: The key/value secrets engine to watch, such as secret.
parameters.name: mount

parameters.description: Only secrets in this folder and the folders under it, such as apps. Leave blank for the whole engine. Up to 200 secrets are watched.
parameters.name: folder

hashicorp_vault_secret_due_for_rotation_.description: Runs once for each secret whose current version is older than the days you choose, such as 90, with its path and age, so it can be changed. Secrets already that old when the workflow is turned on start it too; a new version starts the count again.

output.age_days: Days since its current version was written
output.change: created for a new secret, updated for a new version
output.created_time: When the secret was first written
output.custom_metadata: The secret's custom metadata, such as its owner
output.folder: The folder it's in, such as apps/billing
output.link: A link to the secret in Vault
output.mount: The secrets engine, such as secret
output.name: The last part of its path, such as db
output.path: The secret's path, such as apps/billing/db
output.updated_time: When its current version was written

parameters.description: The key/value secrets engine to watch, such as secret.
parameters.name: mount

parameters.description: Only secrets in this folder and the folders under it, such as apps. Leave blank for the whole engine. Up to 200 secrets are watched.
